name: Jev RAG Chinese Benchmark (S1)
description: First reproducible Chinese-language reranking benchmark for Jev (TypeSafe System One), over hard negatives from C-MTEB/T2Reranking (T2Ranking lineage): 100 queries, pinned model typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917, every API call logged. Results (n=100, single run): Jev Score nDCG@5 0.546 [95% CI 0.481–0.611] vs BM25 0.413 [0.353–0.477]; paired delta +0.133 [95% CI +0.051, +0.232], CI excludes zero; Recall@1 2.4× BM25. Score vs Noul question forms nearly tie for ranking. Total API cost $0.07. Package: technical note (arXiv-ready draft), frozen protocol, results report with bootstrap CIs, full repository snapshot (scripts + per-call JSONL logs). Code: github.com/vicfei/jev-rag-zh-benchmark · Mirrors: HuggingFace / ModelScope · Pattern library: awesome-jev-prompts. Independent community research; not affiliated with TypeSafe AI.
